model_license: Apache-2.0 per official Qwen Hugging Face model card
input: Only public task message and eight public time-response pairs per world; no private holdout, upstream source, benchmark name, or hidden parameters
output: One JSON object with exactly family and reason. family is coupled_bilinear_ode, independent_exponential, or unsure; no arbitrary generated code or coefficients. The prompt avoids the benchmark and textbook law names.
evaluation_boundary: Parser validation first. Fit any valid selected form using only eight public observations, then score held-out responses separately. The coupled candidate is a familiar textbook law and cannot establish novel scientific discovery.
forbidden: No Azure or other closed-source model API; no model access to private results or upstream simulator files
